candidates.title: Microsoft pulls out of Nscale's Loughton (Essex) AI data centre over grid power delay
candidates.summary: Microsoft withdrew as anchor tenant; UK Power Networks reportedly can't supply enough power until the early-to-mid 2030s. Site 50 MW, scalable to 90 MW.
candidates.note: Reuters (Oct 19, via Investing.com/Yahoo/Euronext) confirming Telegraph (Oct 18); ITPro, CGTN, Benzinga, TechTimes. Grid-operator date is 'reportedly' in all coverage; MW figure 50 (FT/Reuters) preferred over TechTimes' 90 headline.

candidates.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund

candidates.note: Runner-up. Official post + CNBC + Al Jazeera + Forbes.
